about_this_app.snippet: Hungry or Need Groceries delivered to your doorstep? 🛍️🍔Welcome to Swiggy, your one-stop shop for online food ordering, groceries, dining, and convenient pickup & delivery!Here's why India LOVES Swiggy 👇- Order food, get grocery delivery, & other essential services online- 30+ cuisines on Swiggy Food.- Swiggy One users get unlimited Free Delivery on all orders- Find top local restaurants like Mcdonald's & Burger King in your city- Order Groceries like Maggi, Dairy Milk Chocolate, and Amul fresh cream & enjoy free delivery with Instamart- Get great discounts by paying dining out bills via Dineout- Late-night delivery- Real-time updates on your order status & an ETA - Make payments via VISA/MasterCard Credit or Debit Cards, Net Banking, Paytm, FreeCharge, MobiKwik wallet, Sodexo Meal Cards, cash on delivery & credit services like LazyPay.🥙 Food Delivery: Order Delicious Food With A Tap 🥙Get Up To 60% Off + Free Delivery with Pocket Hero's picksThat's not all! There are No Minimum Order conditions, so you can order even a single item on Swiggy.Order chicken biryani, Margherita pizza, masala dosa, vegetarian and chicken burgers, coffee, tacos, chicken momos, desserts, and more.Explore our endless range of cuisines, including North Indian, Chinese, South Indian, Thai, Vietnamese, American, Healthy, Street Food, Breakfast, Late-Night Cravings, and more.Get North Indian dishes, Punjabi cuisine, South Indian cuisine, Thai cuisine, and Bengali cuisine with top chains like Domino's Pizza, Wow Momo, KFC, Burger King, Pizza Hut, FreshMenu, McDonald's, Subway, Faasos, Starbucks coffee, and more.- Find local restaurants, breakfast places, brunch spots, cafes & bars🛒 INSTAMART- Get Anything delivered to your doorstep. 🛒Instamart delivers groceries and more to your doorstep. We take care of your groceries, emergency supplies, midnight cravings, cake deliveries, and more.From Lay's chips, Davidoff coffee, and diet coke to fruits, vegetables, Amul ice cream delivery, dairy, Galaxy chocolate, cleaning essentials, personal care products like Santoor soap and Sunsilk shampoo, and baby care, you can find everything here.- Present in 120+ cities, open from 6 a.m. to late at night* for Grocery Essentials like Maggi, Pringles Chips, Nescafe Coffee, and more.*Opening & closing times might vary across cities owing to Govt. regulations.- Grab 30,000+ products across groceries & other categories like toys, stationery, home & kitchen appliances, electronics, beauty & more.🍽️ DINEOUT - deals on dining out at top restaurantsUse Dineout to get up to 50% FLAT discounts with no upper limit on your dining-out bills.Over 40,000+ restaurants across 40 cities additional up to 15% off on your bills with HDFC Bank Credit CardsPre-booking / reserve your table options for hassle-free diningFind the trending cafes, bars, pubs, breweries, luxury dining, kid-friendly, rooftop dining, brunch buffets, and much more! With Swiggy One, you'll experience savings like never before. 🍔 Unlimited free delivery from top restaurants🍕 Extra 30% discount from popular restaurants🛒 Unlimited free delivery on all Instamart orders🚗 No additional surge fee🚂Order Food Delivery In Train IRCTC Delivery 🚂Now, you can enjoy Swiggy's online food delivery even while traveling! With Swiggy's IRCTC delivery service, order food on train from top-rated restaurants at major railway stations and have it delivered directly to your train seat. Enter your train number, and let Swiggy handle the rest.
